attributes.body_ja:
名詞（めいし）の「以来（いらい）」は動詞（どうし）のテ形（けい）や名詞（めいし）と結（むす）びついて、「(A) してから」という意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。これは、(A) をしたときからずっと (B) が続（つづ）いていることを表（あらわ）す表現（ひょうげん）です。

「以来（いらい）」のポイントは、それが「継続（けいぞく）中（ちゅう）の状態（じょうたい）」であることです。 この文型（ぶんけい）では (B) が外的（がいてき）な原因（げんいん）によって途切（とぎ）れるまでずっと続（つづ）くものであることに焦点（しょうてん）が当（あ）てられています。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

「以来（いらい）」は (A) をしたときから今（いま）までに (B) が起（お）こった回数（かいすう）を表（あらわ）すこともあります。「以来（いらい）」を使（つか）うことで、単（たん）に「から」を使（つか）うよりも、(B) の回数（かいすう）に対（たい）する驚（おどろ）きを強調（きょうちょう）することができます。
attributes.body:
When the noun, 以来（いらい） 'ever since' is paired with the て-form of verbs, or with nouns, it indicates that (B) is something that has continued non-stop since (A), or will continue non-stop from (A). This may be interpreted as 'since (A)', 'henceforth', or 'ever since (A)'.

The key point of 以来（いらい） is that it indicates an ongoing state. Due to this, it focuses on (B) being something that will continue non-stop until a change is caused externally.

Caution

Occasionally, 以来（いらい） may also be used to express a specific number of (B) that has occurred since (A). While this use is closer to 'since', it still just indicates that 'in total', (B) has occurred 'ever since (A)'. This will place a stronger emphasis on the amount of (B) being shocking in some way than a simpler structure like から.

attributes.source: 新完全マスター文法 N2

attributes.description: してこのかた and して以来

attributes.body: Both mark a point after which something changes, but the meaning and outlook are very different. たら最後 expresses a strong, often negative inevitability, meaning “once (A) happens, that’s it,” and implies that things will go badly or cannot be undone, as in 一度言ったら最後、もう取り消せない (‘Once you say it, that’s it, you can’t take it back.’). By contrast, 以来 is a neutral, factual expression meaning “since,” used to state that a situation has continued from a certain point in the past without emotional judgment, as in 日本に来て以来、日本語を勉強している (‘I’ve been studying Japanese since I came to Japan.’).

first_relatable.title: たら最後
first_relatable.meaning: Once, Now that, As soon as

attributes.body: 以来 and 以上② can both be translated as since, but function differently. 以来 marks a continuous state from a past point, as in 事故以来、運転していない (I haven’t driven since the accident). 以上② expresses conditional logic or justification, as in 勝負する以上、全力でやってみたい (Since I’m going to compete, I want to give it my all).

second_relatable.title: 以上 ②
second_relatable.meaning: Since, Now that, As long as, If

attributes.body: 以来 and 上は can both be translated as since, but their usage is quite different. 以来 means since in the sense of time, as in 日本に来て以来、毎日日本語を使っている (Since coming to Japan, I use Japanese every day). 上は means since as in because of the given situation, as in 日本に来た上は、たくさんの日本人と話したい (Since I came to Japan, I want to speak to many Japanese people).
